entries.40fffd07b0028fba: A reportable segment that buys and sells reuse goods exclusively over the internet, without stores. Through the comprehensive buy-back site 'Takaku Ureru Dotcom', it manages used goods purchased from general individuals and corporations at 15 reuse centers nationwide, sells them under the 'ReRe' brand by listing them on major online marketplaces, and also operates the platform 'Oikura', which matches consumers with reuse shops nationwide. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥13,183 million.
entries.6f78ad6f818a4295: Its registered head office is in Sumida-ku, Tokyo, while actual operations are conducted at its head office in Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. The company and 4 consolidated subsidiaries form the group, and as of June 30, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 366. Its shares are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
